scope: Offline Freerouting bakeoff only; no accepted PCB, manifest, CAD, or repository files modified.

tooling.network_use: No board upload or routing service; analytics, API server, MCP server, and job saving disabled.

pad_count_explanations.BT1: Two physical pads share pad number 1; schematic has one pin 1.
pad_count_explanations.BT2: Two physical pads share pad number 1; schematic has one pin 1.
pad_count_explanations.J1: Board has electrical pads 1/2 plus two MP pads; schematic has pins 1/2.
pad_count_explanations.J2: Board has electrical pads 1/2 plus two MP pads; schematic has pins 1/2.
pad_count_explanations.U1: Board has the nine schematic-numbered pads plus one unnumbered physical pad.

external_parser_16_reference_cross_check.conclusion: The external parser's 16-component missing-schematic classification is not supported by the native source. Fourteen are present with exact symbol UUID path linkage; MH1/MH2 are the only true schematic-absent board footprints. The observed extra physical pads explain count differences for BT1, BT2, J1, J2 and U1, not missing component references.

prepared_exchange.limitation: DSN omitted actual filled planes; contact-metal constraints and unrestricted through-via safety were not qualified. F-only/no-via was intentionally used.

no_routing_control.assessment: Usable only as an exchange-churn comparison baseline; not source-preserving.

c_sample_route_attempt.assessment: Rejected. Native connectivity did not improve, while the routing-enabled exchange produced substantial non-target F.Cu geometry differences despite protected wiring and ignored net classes. The engine's completion state and internal unrouted count are not evidence of board routing completion.

engineering_concerns: No requested C-net open was closed.
Routing-enabled exchange was not stable relative to the no-routing control and altered non-target protected-net geometry representation.
The engine reported 190 internal clearance violations even though native KiCad DRC returned the unchanged accepted finding counts.
Actual F/In1 filled-ground connectivity remained unchanged only after native refill; DSN plane outlines were deliberately removed and did not prove return continuity.
Battery-contact metal and safe unrestricted through-via constraints remain outside the qualified DSN model.

human_and_automation_burden.cli_automation: Repeatable offline export, DSN normalization, control/run, SES import, native refill, DRC, graph, and SVG generation are scripted.
human_and_automation_burden.manual_burden: High: the raw result would require identifying and selectively transplanting only legitimate new copper, but this attempt produced no completed target connection and broad non-target churn. Manual trace cleanup was intentionally not attempted.

recommendation: Do not stage or integrate this candidate and do not run the optional breadth sample. Freerouting 2.4.1 showed no useful leverage under the conservative F-only/no-via/protected-copper recipe. Any future trial needs a demonstrated class/protection isolation control or a smaller source-derived routing fixture before spending another engine run.
